Enabled FEAT_MTE2 nonstreaming register-only ADDG/SUBG/GMI/SUBP/SUBPS with fixed ATA0=1, TCF0=0 and GCR.Exclude=0. All allocated immediates, GPR/SP/ZR roles, aliases, 56-bit signed pointer subtraction, tag arithmetic and SUBPS NZCV effects. Nonzero should-be-zero ADDG/SUBG op3 selects the source-permitted execute-as-zero behavior; original QEMU UNDEF and requested FP storage differences are retained separately and receive no original equality credit. No guest RAM access, allocation-tag storage, IRG randomness, tag-check faults, tagged host dereference, disabled-feature/access behavior or Apple hardware conformance is inferred.

Enabled FP/AdvSIMD. Every allocated 8/16/32-bit lane, width and Q half variant; ordinary V31 and all source/old-destination aliases. Signed/unsigned halving uses mathematical carry/borrow and round bias before truncation. High-half narrowing and XTN preserve low halves for 2 forms and clear upper halves for lower forms. Pairwise widening extends before summation/optional modular accumulation; SHLL shifts selected input halves by full original lane width. NZCV/FPCR/FPSR and RAM unchanged. No disabled-feature exceptions, SME streaming, FP arithmetic or full application claim.

Enabled FP/AdvSIMD. Every allocated vector width and integer lane size; V31 ordinary data and all aliases. Independent byte CNT/RBIT/NOT and 8/16/32-bit CLZ/CLS, including zero/all-one and all leading counts. Q=0 upper clearing. NZCV/FPCR/FPSR and guest RAM unchanged. No disabled-feature exceptions, SME streaming, FP arithmetic or complete application claim.

Enabled FlagM/FlagM2 register-only profile with architectural NZCV. CFINV toggles C; RMIF selectively copies rotated Xn bits; SETF8/16 sets NZV from Wn and preserves C; AXFLAG/XAFLAG perform declared Boolean transforms. Register31 is ZR; ignored CRm bits follow pinned decode. All unrelated state and ordinary guest RAM are preserved. No complete PSTATE/DIT, disabled-feature guest exception delivery, application or OS compatibility claim.

Enabled nonstreaming FP/AdvSIMD and SHA3. EOR3/BCAX three-source logic, qword RAX1 and every XAR immediate 0..63; all register roles and aliases. Full 128-bit destination, NZCV/FPCR/FPSR and guest RAM preserved. Disabled access, streaming/SVE spellings and Apple hardware remain outside scope.

FEAT_HBC enabled. All16 conditions and signed imm19 times4 targets under the existing nonwrapping guest-address profile. Conditional transfer preserves all GPR/SP/NZCV/FP/SIMD state and returns actual next guest PC/exit kind to serialized dispatch. Bit4 supplies a consistent-direction prediction hint with no additional architectural state effect. GCS is disabled and executable pages are unguarded; no PSTATE.BTYPE, exception delivery, hardware predictor identity or application execution claim.

Single-to-BF16 conversion classifies original Single NaNs, quiets/truncates payload and rounds once to seven stored fraction bits under the exact source-denormal and target-tininess rules. Scalar NEP merges original Vd above bit15; narrow lower clears high64 and narrow upper preserves original low64. AH=0 uses checked controls and precisely refuses retained numerical enables. AH=1 forces FIZ/FZ and RNE, retains AH NaN/default/flush semantics and commits zero fresh exceptions. Integer rounding/packing requires no host FP environment. Enabled AArch64 non-streaming FP/AdvSIMD/AFP/BF16 profile with FEAT_EBF16 absent. Raw FPCR bit13 cannot select extended arithmetic; AHP/FZ16 do not convert BF16 into IEEE Half. V registers are ordinary data, all legal aliases use original snapshots, and vector operations ignore scalar NEP. Results and any fresh sticky FPSR stage before one transactional commit. FPCR, NZCV, GPR/SP, unrelated vectors, RAM and caller MXCSR are preserved. All forms retain an interior numerical helper and consume the instruction plus RET. Retained enables may succeed only under the family control policy; architectural enabled trap delivery remains outside scope. No SVE/SME, EBF16-enabled profile, numerical leaf ABI, disabled-feature checks, Apple hardware, application or OS execution is established.

Extended Multiply preserves ordinary multiplication rounding/NaN priority except that effective zero-times-infinity returns signed 2.0 without IOC; the sign is the XOR of input signs. Input flushing occurs first, and post-arithmetic denormal status follows non-NaN shortcuts. All encoded lane indices are covered. Indexed H selects V0–V15 using H:L:M; S/D select V0–V31 using H:L or H, with Double L=0. Q=0 may select the upper half of the full indexed source. Scalar NEP merges original Vn; vectors ignore scalar NEP, evaluate active lanes only and clear Q=0 upper 64 bits. V0–V31 are ordinary data where allocated and legal aliases preserve all original sources. Enabled AArch64 non-streaming FP/AdvSIMD/FP16/AFP profile; H is IEEE half and AHP is ignored. All retained numerical exception enables refuse before effects, including AH=1. Destination and fresh sticky FPSR commit transactionally, preserving FPCR, NZCV, unrelated registers, RAM and caller MXCSR. Normal vector H4/H8 products use packed SSE2 exact Single multiplication with integer Half rounding and guarded result/status acceptance. New H and S/D forms retain conditional interior helper exits and consume the instruction plus RET; existing elementwise H Add/Subtract/Multiply/Divide keep their terminal boundary. No numerical leaf ABI, enabled trap delivery, disabled-FP access, streaming SME, application or OS execution is established.

SME2p1 streaming Q16 comprises DUPQ, EXTQ, TBLQ, TBXQ, ZIPQ1/2,
UZPQ1/2 and ADDQV, ANDQV, EORQV, ORQV, SMAXQV, SMINQV, UMAXQV, UMINQV.
The shared typed SME2p1 requirement and streaming guard admit only an explicit
V2 SME/SME2/SME2p1 declaration at SVL16/32/64/128/256, independently of ZA.
The chosen V2 specialization carries DIT=0, maximum SVL and ZT0 permission as
immutable profile/manifest identity; this is no blanket architectural DIT rule
for the sixteen instructions. Only a selected scalar TBLQ/TBXQ gather needs the
additional explicit-DIT0 recipe guard. Checked SSSE3 byte PSHUFB has no added
DIT restriction. Other Q forms receive no table-recipe guard. This is the SME-
derived streaming alternative, not general SVE2p1 or a hardware feature capture.
Rearrangements preserve architectural segment/index/alias semantics. Quadword
reductions combine matching element positions across 128-bit chunks, apply the
operation identity to inactive positions and clear current Z bits above the low
128-bit result. ADDQV wraps at element width. All source aliases are read before
writeback. GPRs, NZCV, FP storage, predicates, ZA, ZT0, SVCR and TPIDR2 survive.
Original FFR/FPMR and DIT readback are unobserved; runtime scalable cache execution,
MOVPRFX pairs, resumable faults, applications and macOS boot remain unverified.
